usage: 洗手盆 is a noun used to refer to the sink, typically found in bathrooms or kitchens.
It can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
When describing its location, you can add words like '喺' (at) before 洗手盆.
You can talk about actions involving the 洗手盆 like 洗手 (wash hands) or 洗嘢 (wash things) using verbs with it.
It is a common household item and often mentioned when discussing home or bathroom furniture.
